looks.label: 현실 모습
identityInstructions: He is a forty-two-year-old Korean man with a round face, a receding hairline, and visibly thinning short black hair.
Give him dark-brown eyes, faint uneven stubble, and a slightly oily forehead.
Keep him short with a stocky heavy build and a protruding belly.
outfitInstructions: Dress him in an ill-fitting charcoal suit jacket, a tight muted-navy shirt collar, and a wine-red tie.
Give him an old leather briefcase and a company phone.
fullBodyOnlyInstructions: Use visibly worn black dress shoes.
characterUndesiredInstructions: A youthful handsome face, a sharp jawline, full hair, a clean-shaven face, a tall slim frame, broad heroic shoulders, glamorous grooming, or a heroic pose.

situations.label: 반응을 기다리는 미소
situations.description: 상대가 원하는 반응을 할 때까지 미소를 유지합니다.
instructions: Lean his upper body toward someone just off camera and hold the closed-mouth smile for uncomfortably long while waiting for a reaction.

situations.label: 책상 옆에서 답을 기다림
situations.description: 상대의 책상 쪽으로 몸을 기울인 채 반응을 기다립니다.
instructions: Stand beside another person's desk, lean forward, and hold the closed-mouth smile for uncomfortably long while waiting for a reaction.

situations.label: 거절 뒤의 짜증
situations.description: 거절을 자신의 권리에 대한 모욕처럼 받아들입니다.
instructions: Tighten his jaw and mouth while looking at someone just off camera with visible irritation.

situations.label: 복도에서 퇴로 막기
situations.description: 괴물화하지 않고 거리·자세·막힌 출입문으로 압박을 표현합니다.
instructions: Stand too close to the foreground person, block part of the doorway, and look down at them with a neutral closed-mouth smile.

looks.label: 자기 인식 속 미남
identityInstructions: He is a forty-two-year-old handsome Korean man with thick neatly styled black hair, a sharp jawline, and relaxed dark-brown eyes.
Keep him tall, lean, broad-shouldered, and meticulously well groomed.
outfitInstructions: Dress him in a fitted charcoal suit, a muted-navy shirt, and a wine-red tie.
characterUndesiredInstructions: Thinning hair, short stature, a protruding belly, an ill-fitting suit, oily skin, or looming posture.

situations.label: 여유로운 중년 미남
situations.description: 스스로 넉넉하고 다정하다고 믿는 기본 모습입니다.
instructions: Use a relaxed posture and a confident gentle smile while looking slightly down toward the viewer.

situations.label: 주관 화면 · 다정한 접근
situations.description: 상대에게 다가서는 행동을 세련된 배려라고 인식합니다.
instructions: Stand beside an office desk with a relaxed posture, a confident gentle smile, and one hand loosely holding a phone.

situations.label: 주관 화면 · 상처받은 남자
situations.description: 거절 뒤의 감정을 사랑 때문에 받은 상처로 재구성합니다.
instructions: Use an upright posture, a pained restrained smile, downcast eyes, and one hand held near his tie with romantic melancholy.
